remarks: Shippan waterfront living at its finest. Situated directly on the Long Island Sound, this 4+ bedroom, 4-bath residence offers 75 feet of sweeping, unobstructed frontage-placing the shoreline quite literally at your doorstep. At low tide, a private sandy stretch emerges, creating a beachfront setting ideal for launching kayaks, paddle boards, or mooring a boat.  Inside, light-filled interiors flow effortlessly from an open, updated kitchen to spacious entertaining areas, all designed to maximize the water views. Each of the four full baths has been thoughtfully renovated with a timeless design, blending sophistication and comfort. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a bluestone patio, and a seawall. A detached two-car garage provides convenience and storage.  Life in Shippan offers the perfect balance of seaside serenity and city accessibility. Stamford's vibrant downtown-with its restaurants, shopping, and cultural events-is just minutes away, while Shippan itself remains a quiet, intimate neighborhood where the sound of waves sets the rhythm of daily life. And with the Metro-North train whisking you to Manhattan in under 50 minutes, the home is perfectly suited for both full-time living and a weekend escape.  64 Ocean Drive East is more than a residence-it's a rare opportunity to enjoy the tranquility of a waterfront retreat with all the energy of city living within easy reach.  Listing agent is related to seller.
